name: Doki Doki Switcheroo!
source:
Doki Doki with a twist! Featuring brand new sprites, new music, and (technically) new characters, play as a female protagonist as you try to win over your favorite Doki in a genderbent literature club!

[Based from [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/switcheroo]DokiMods[/url]]
translation:
《心跳文学部》迎来全新变化！采用全新立绘、新音乐和（严格来说）新角色，扮演女性主人公，在性转文学社中赢得你最喜欢的社员的芳心！

[基于[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/switcheroo]DokiMods[/url]]
